summary: Frontend-only whole-site link and regression verification passed on the public preview at desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844. All rendered anchors have valid destinations (no href='#'); all 10 external anchors use target='_blank' and rel='noopener noreferrer'. Desktop/mobile navigation, logo and footer scrolling, contact email/social attributes, project destinations/placeholders, preloaders, and both contact-form toast flows passed with no application mutation, console errors, or page errors.
seed_data_creation: None; frontend-only testing and the demo contact form sent no application mutation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend intentionally skipped. Desktop anchor inventory contained 13 anchors: 10 external, one mailto, and two intentional href-less project-002 image/title wrappers; none used href='#'. GitHub social rendered exactly once with the required attributes, while LinkedIn/TwitterX/Dribbble were absent. Desktop nav targets landed at 90px; nav-logo and footer-back-to-top reached scrollY 0. Mobile Work/About/Skills/Contact changed scrollY and closed the drawer. Fresh preloaders detached in 4.69s desktop and 4.70s mobile. All four missing images rendered numbered radial-gradient placeholders. Empty/valid contact submissions showed error/success toasts; valid submission cleared fields. An initial test assertion counted Cloudflare/Emergent preview telemetry POSTs as form mutations; the corrected request-scoped check excluded platform telemetry and confirmed zero app mutation. ESLint static analysis passed with no issues.
rca_of_the_issue: The prior Contact dead-link defect is resolved: Contact filters PROFILE.socials through isReal before rendering, so only GitHub appears, and the rendered anchor has the required href/new-tab security attributes with no social preventDefault handler. Placeholder '#' entries never enter the DOM.
